corpus.origin: Hand-authored examples and the existing 32-case translation corpus; no model tuning against results.

protocol: Models initialized once. Three full untimed corpus passes, followed by fifteen timings per example. Each example uses its median; aggregate latency is the upper median of those 150 medians. Accuracy is one top prediction per example; unknown counts as incorrect. All detection runs offline. File I/O and initialization excluded from latency; one observed process-local initialization time reported separately, not a cold-disk benchmark.
runtimes: Firefox exact CLD2 generated JavaScript and .mem assets run in a Node VM with asynchronous local XMLHttpRequest emulation. CLD3 through cld3-asm 4.0.0 WebAssembly. TinyLD 1.3.4 and franc-min 6.2.0 JavaScript. Application Lingua .NET 2.0.0 assembly, .NET 10 Release. Node v26.13.0 is a test runner only. Browser/worker message transport excluded.
constraints: Lingua restricted to application seven languages. TinyLD and franc tested with built-in seven-language allowlists and open-language defaults. CLD2 and CLD3 use their full language inventories, so these configurations have different candidate counts. CLD3 input limits 0..1000 bytes; all corpus examples fit. franc minLength=0 permits single-word predictions.
sizes: Uncompressed inference code and model assets, decimal units. Shared .NET/Node/browser runtimes, packaging metadata, licenses, duplicate browser builds and source maps excluded. CLD3 counts loaded CommonJS dependency files including its embedded WASM. Lingua low retains the full model set. A separate low-trimmed experiment keeps only seven trigram files; its lower accuracy is reported separately. The application package remains unchanged.
limitations: A small application-focused sample, not a population accuracy estimate. Single-word expectations reflect the intended language; ambiguous words can be shared. Performance compares these actual implementations, not only the abstract algorithms.

mediapipe.source: Extracted the default model from the scanned Panlingo.LanguageIdentification.MediaPipe 0.8.2 managed package. The source generator embeds the original Google model without transformation. Direct Google Storage downloads returned a location access error.
mediapipe.runtime: Official SIMD WebAssembly runtime. Node local-file importScripts shim, preloaded wasmBinary, CPU XNNPACK delegate.
mediapipe.constraints: Both unrestricted and built-in seven-language categoryAllowlist; maxResults=1, scoreThreshold=0.

fasttext.models: Official Meta lid.176.ftz and lid.176.bin files; no model conversion.
fasttext.runtime: Unmodified precompiled fastText WebAssembly package. Its downloaded WASM received scanner exit code 0 before execution. Global fetch disabled for local filesystem loading in modern Node.
fasttext.constraints: Unrestricted top-1 and seven-language selection from all 176 ranked predictions. The latter is output filtering, not retraining. Line breaks replaced with spaces because fastText expects a single line. Returned native prediction vectors deleted after every call.
